# Title: IPnoise
# Description: IPs caught attacking a distributed network of interactive
#   honeypot sensors -- hosts running no legitimate service, advertised
#   nowhere, so every connection reaching them is hostile by construction.
#   The sensors answer, emulating real services well enough to record what
#   each source actually came to do: credential attacks, exploit and
#   malware-delivery attempts, CMS and admin-panel enumeration, SSH brute
#   force. Listed after repeated hostile activity within a short sliding
#   window; captured payloads are never published.

# License: free for any use
# Retention: entries expire 1 day after last activity
